slice: stock tires from Yamaha YZ65 / YZ85 owner's manuals (gap fill)
method: Stock tires per roster bike-year where BAK had no stock tire size and model yet (checked against every docs/research/knowledge file on 2026-11-07). Read from the bike maker's owner's manual or spec page; printed values kept as printed, odd ones noted.

records.topic: 2020 Yamaha YZ65: stock tire sizes, models and cold pressure
records.statement: Yamaha's 2020 YZ65 owner's manual lists a 60/100-14 30M front and 80/100-12 41M rear, Maxxis Maxxcross SI front and rear (tube type), at 100 kPa (15 psi) cold front and rear; minimum tread depth 4.0 mm.
